sel_install_online: Kɛwo mli kɛjɛ nibii ni aŋmala ashwie shi lɛ amli...

settings_sp_auth_desc: Halamɔ diɛŋtsɛ. MediaTek otii komɛi kpooɔ akɛ amɛbaatswa kɛyashi be mli ni aha SP Flash Tool lɛ nɔmimaa (.auth) faili; kɛ onɔ̃ lɛ afata he yɛ biɛ kɛji akɛ tsɔne lɛ he miihia.

status_terminal_install: Install famɔ ni agbele yɛ o-terminal samflɛ mli ({gbɛ}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_gbɛi} baagbele foidamɔ {gbɛ}.

• Kɛji egbooo momo lɛ, gbemɔ o-{device} lɛ.
• Kɛ́ ekɛ USB ebɔ he lɛ, gbálamɔ mli klɛŋklɛŋ.
{tsɔɔmɔ}
• Okɛ otsɔne lɛ atsa okɔmpiuta lɛ nɔ kɛji {terminal_name} samflɛ lɛ egbele.

Klikimɔ OK nɔ koni oje Updater CE lɛ shishi ni oje mli.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ŋaawoo: Kɛ́ tsɔne lɛ kɛ ehe kpaaa gbee lɛ, nyɛɛ reset button ni yɔɔ pinhole lɛ mli lɛ nɔ blɛoo kɛ wolo ni akɛwoɔ tsɔne mli lɛ be mli ni okɛ USB kpã lɛ miitswa lɛ.
terminal_hint_generic: • Ŋaawoo: Okɛ otsɔne lɛ awo firmware download mode mli (esoroɔ lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ naa: nɔkwɛmɔnɔ, jiemɔ batiri ni okɛ USB kpã ebɔ he, loo gbemɔ la kɛ batri ni yɔɔ mli, loo mɔmɔ Volume Down/Up lɛ mli beni okɛ USB lɛ ebɔ he lɛ).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Kɛwo mli kɛtsɔ SP Flash dɛŋdade GUI nɔ
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI lɛ baagbele kɛ o-firmware lɛ ni akɛwo mli momo.

• Yɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ mli lɛ, halamɔ "Format All + Download" kɛjɛ adeka ni baa shi lɛ mli.
• Nyɛɛ "Download" lɛ nɔ.
• Kwɛmɔ akɛ o-{device} lɛ egbo ni efo mli.
{tsɔɔmɔ}
• Okɛ USB kpã lɛ awo okɔmpiuta lɛ nɔ kɛ́ onyɛ Download lɛ nɔ.

Klikimɔ OK nɔ koni okɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ atsu nii ni oje Updater CE lɛ mli.
settings_rockbox_desc: Akɛtsu nii kɛji ootao Rockbox kpojiemɔi kɛha Y1.
settings_filter_nightly: Tsɔɔmɔ Gbi Dev Nibii ni Ajieɔ lɛ kpo
settings_filter_240p: 240p Rock Adeka ni Ajieɔ lɛ kpo
settings_240p_tip: Tsɔɔmɔ tsui ni ROM zip lɛ ji 240p henɔ (rom..._240p.zip). 240p tsui lɛ kɛ Y1 nibii ni yɔɔ Innioasis OS ni yɔɔ 3.0.7 shishi lɛ kpãaa gbee, no hewɔ lɛ Tsɔɔmɔ Rockbox Tsui Momo lɛ etsu nii kɛtsu nii.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Rockbox-Y1 ni ajie lɛ kpo dani 0.5 lɛ kɛ Y1 ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ March 2026 sɛɛ ni akɛ Innioasis OS 3.0.7 wo mli momo lɛ kpãaa gbee.

Kɛji ootswa build momo ko yɛ tsɔnei nɛɛ anɔ lɛ, ebaatsi booting naa.

Ani oyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ oosumɔ ni otsɔɔ Rockbox tsui ni etsɛ?

settings_offline_mode_desc: Tee intanɛt akutsoŋ wolo lɛ ni okɛ firmware awo mli kɛjɛ akutsoŋ faili pɛ mli.
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Ani okɛ Rockbox 360p Yitso lɛ awo mli?
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Okɛ 360p Rockbox tsu ko etsɔɔ. Ani obaasumɔ ni okɛ 360p Theme Pack lɛ awo tsɔne nɛɛ nɔ bianɛ?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Kɛ Player lɛ abɔ USB nitoohe lɛ he
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Ofainɛ, gbálamɔ USB lɛ, wo hewalɛ ni okɛwo Rockbox mli shikome (no hewɔ lɛ ejeɔ emli .rockbox gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ shishi), ni okɛ USB lɛ atsa ekoŋŋ ni ohala 'USB Storage Mode'.

Kɛ́ okɛ lɛ tsa lɛ, nyɛɛ Continue nɔ koni ohala folda fɛɛ folda ni yɔɔ o-player lɛ nɔ lɛ.

dialog_pre_install_header: Ofainɛ kwɛmɔ akɛ o {model} lɛ egbo ni USB kɛ ehe kpaaa gbee
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Gbemɔ otsɔne lɛ mli hewalɛ kwraa dani obɔi nitsumɔ.
• Kɛ́ tsɔne lɛ mli ewo fɛ̃i loo etsuuu nii lɛ, okɛ pin loo wolo ni akɛwoɔ tsɔne lɛ mli lɛ atsu nii ni okɛnyɛ tsɔne lɛ nɔ ni egbe tsɔne lɛ mli kɛya download mode mli.
• Ha USB kpã lɛ akatswa amrɔ nɛɛ.
• Nyɛɛ Continue nɔ, no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ́ abi bo lɛ, okɛ otsɔne lɛ atsa USB nɔ.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Gbe o-MediaTek tsɔne lɛ mli hewalɛ kwraa.
• Ha USB kpã lɛ akatswa amrɔ nɛɛ.

sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash dɛŋdade GUI lɛ baaje shishi agbɛnɛ.

• Kɛ́ egbooo momo lɛ, gbemɔ otsɔne lɛ.
• Kɛ́ ekɛ USB ebɔ he lɛ, gbálamɔ mli klɛŋklɛŋ.
• Yɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛɛ Download (loo Format Fɛɛ + Gbalamɔ bɔ ni he hiaa).

No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ USB kpã lɛ abɔ he ni ebɔi ŋmɔlɔ.

donate_intro_success:
Wɔkɛ {sɔftwɛɛ} wo o{mɔdɛl} lɛ nɔ.

Kwɛmɔ! Miji Ryan, mɔ ni fee Updater CE, Akutsoŋ Firmware Nibii Atoohe lɛ, kɛ Themes Gallery lɛ sɛɛ. Mikɛ wɔ ~$200 nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ sɛɛva kɛ nitoohe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ woɔ kotoku mli koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ahi shi yaka ni agbele naa. Kɛji dɛŋdade nɛɛ ye ebua bo lɛ, ofainɛ susumɔ oniatsumɔ he — ehaa nibii nɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛhaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
donate_intro_general: Agóo! Miji Ryan, mɔ ni fee Updater CE, Akutsoŋ Firmware Nibii Atoohe lɛ, kɛ Themes Gallery lɛ sɛɛ. Miwoɔ sɛɛva hosting, firmware nibii ni akɛtoɔ, kɛ domain heefeemɔ he nyɔmɔ kɛjɛɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mikotoku mli koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ akafee yaka. Nyɔji amli nibii ni akɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ baashɛɔ aaafee dɔlai 200 — yelikɛbuamɔ fɛɛ yelikɛbuamɔ ni okɛhaa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa dɛŋdadei nɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛhaa nuŋtsɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

themepack_card_title: Kɛ 360p Rockbox Yitso lɛ awo mli
themepack_card_desc: Akutsoŋ saji otii fɛfɛji, sɛɛgbɛ nibii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, kɛ niŋmaa okadii ni afee pɔtɛɛ aha 360p nibii ni ajieɔ lɛ kpo lɛ fata he.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ Akɛ 360p Theme Pack lɛ ewo mli jogbaŋŋ!
themepack_step1_title: Nɔ ni ji 1: Kɛ USB Storage Mode lɛ abɔ he
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Sumɔ o-player lɛ kɛtsɔ Power button lɛ ni ooomɔ nɔ.
2. Kɛ́ Rockbox lɛ bɔi nitsumɔ lɛ, okɛ USB kpã lɛ awo okɔmpiuta lɛ mli.
3. Kɛ́ abi bo yɛ tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ nɔ lɛ, maa USB Storage mode lɛ nɔ mi koni tsɔne lɛ ajie ehe kpo akɛ draiva.
themepack_step2_title: Nɔ ni ji enyɔ: Halamɔ Folda fɛɛ Folder ni yɔɔ Player lɛ nɔ lɛ
themepack_step2_desc: Akɛni tsɔnei ni akɛtsuɔ nii (tamɔ macOS) lɛ kɛ dotfiles (tamɔ .rockbox) teeɔ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, obaanyɛ ohala folda FƐƐ FOLDA loo drive root ni yɔɔ o-player lɛ nɔ lɛ. Wɔbaana loo wɔbaafee .rockbox gbɛtsɔɔmɔ wolo lɛ wɔha bo.
themepack_complete: Akɛ Theme pack lɛ wo mli jogbaŋŋ! Amrɔ nɛɛ obaanyɛ ojie o-player lɛ kɛjɛ mli shweshweeshwe ni ohala saneyitso ko yɛ Rockbox lɛ mli (Shitooi > Saneyitso lɛ He Gbɛjianɔtoi).
themepack_err_not_found: Anyɛɛɛ ana loo aje .rockbox gbɛtsɔɔmɔ shishi yɛ draiva ni ahala lɛ nɔ. Ofainɛ kwɛmɔ akɛ ohala folda ko yɛ o-player lɛ nɔ.
rockbox_wizard_title: Rockbox 360p Yitsoi kɛ Niŋmaa He Gbɛjianɔtoo
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Kwɛmɔ kɛya USB Nitoohe Mode lɛ nɔ
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Nɔ ni ji 1: Je shwɛmɔ lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Gbalamɔ USB kpã lɛ.
2. Ha shwɛlɔ lɛ hewalɛ ekoŋŋ ni oha ebote Rockbox mli.
3. Kɛ́ Rockbox lɛ miitsu nii lɛ, okɛ USB kpã lɛ abɔ he ekoŋŋ, ni onyɛ Continue nɔ.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Nɔ ni ji enyɔ: Miitao shwɛlɔ lɛ yɛ ADB nɔ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App lɛ miikwɛ ADB tsakpaa (kɛyashi sɛkɛndii 30). Kɛji ana tsɔne ko lɛ, ajieɔ themes lɛ kɛyaa he kroko ni player lɛ jeɔ shishi ekoŋŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, yaa hiɛ kɛya USB Nitoohe Mode lɛ nɔ.
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Ana tsɔne ({serial}); saji otii ni akɛyaa he kroko...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: ADB tsɔne ko bɛ ni ana yɛ sɛkɛndii 30 mli; ni yaa nɔ kɛ USB Nitoohe Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binary ko bɛ ni yɔɔ app lɛ mli; ni yaa nɔ kɛ USB Nitoohe Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Miitsi saji otii kɛ niŋmaa okadii lɛ anaa yɛ ADB nɔ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB sɛɛkuu lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsu nii; ni baa shi kɛyaa USB Nitoohe Mode lɛ nɔ
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Kɛ USB nitoohe lɛ awo mli
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Ha USB Storage Mode lɛ atsu nii yɛ tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ nɔ koni ejie ehe kpo akɛ draiva.
2. Halamɔ folda FƐƐ FOLDA ni yɔɔ shwɛmɔ tsɔne ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ nɔ (.rockbox, Lala, Saji otii, loo draiva shishijee — .rockbox folda ko ni yɔɔ teemɔŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ).
3. App lɛ kɛ 360p themes kɛ fonts lɛ feɔ ekome, ni eŋmalaa gbɛi kome faili lɛ nɔ.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: 360p saji otii kɛ niŋmaa okadii ni akɛwo mli!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Amrɔ nɛɛ obaanyɛ ojie tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ shweshweeshwe ni ohala saneyitso ko yɛ Rockbox lɛ mli (Shitooi > Saneyitso lɛ He Gbɛjianɔtoi).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Updater lɛ eko ni etsɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ kɔmpiuta nɛɛ nɔ lolo ni eŋɔ he ko yɛ disk lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ ojie kɛjɛ mli lɛ, ebaaha nakai he lɛ aya hiɛ.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Ekɛ he ko ni miihe ashɛ {dalɛ} yɛ disk lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Jiemɔ Innioasis Updater nitsumɔ momo kɛ yelikɛbuamɔ woji lɛ
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Ha Android gbɛjianɔtoo nibii (ADB / Fastboot) awo mli
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Kɛji okɛ ADB loo Fastboot tsuuu nii yɛ Updater CE lɛ kponɔ lɛ, jiemɔ nɔ ni okɛjie lɛ ni okɛ nibii krokomɛi ni akɛtoɔ lɛ aba ekoŋŋ.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Atsumɔ gboshinii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ mli yɛ omanyeyeli mli ni ana disk he gbɛ ekoŋŋ.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Updater lɛ henɔ momo ko yɛ kɔmpiuta nɛɛ nɔ lolo. Kɛ́ ojie kɛjɛ mli lɛ, ehaa disk lɛ nɔ he ko baaje kpo.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Enɛ jieɔ app momo lɛ kɛ esɛɛfimɔ faili lɛ. Akɛ firmware ni ajie lɛ eto.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Ani ojieɔ Android gbɛjianɔtoo nibii (ADB / Fastboot) lɛ hu? Halamɔ Keep kɛji okɛ ADB miitsu nii.
